blocked_source.full_rows_and_source_audit_test_set: always retained for valid blocked input
blocked_source.selected_DE_table: header only; MUST NOT be consumed as a valid empty DE set

exit_codes.0: CLASSIFIED; an evaluated empty set is valid and explicitly count0
exit_codes.2: invalid inputs/parameters/IO or non-core warning; output directory may be partial and must be discarded
exit_codes.3: valid source NO_TESTABLE; preserved bundle, no DE conclusion
exit_codes.4: valid source REVIEW_REQUIRED; preserved bundle, no DE conclusion

required_before_any_publish: source_result_id and its original full manifest SHA256
exact source three artifact pins + original contrast/job/lineage binding
classification core/contract version and source pins
complete derived six-artifact manifest and exit/audit state

parameters.tsv.absolute_log2fc_min: explicit finite numeric token >=0, in log2FC units
parameters.tsv.additional_or_missing_keys: reject; no FC ratio parameter/conversion or silent defaults

test-set.tsv.rows: complete exact association to results; same order/P token/status/reason

ordinary_rule.FC: copied as original; not used to threshold; overflow/underflow FC does not reclassify a testable log2FC
ordinary_rule.NS: other evaluated testable rows, including exact0 and -0 even at cutoff0
ordinary_rule.not_testable: original not_testable; independent from NS and never DE
ordinary_rule.testable_row_gate: test_status=testable with original finite log2FC and adjusted P; NA in a testable row is invalid

classification-audit.tsv.status_and_counts: explicit source status, DE-members-evaluated, thresholds, Up/Down/NS/not_testable/not_evaluated counts, selected count and original BH metadata

classification.tsv.prefix: every original source row line/18 tokens copied byte-for-byte before two appended fields

limits.basis: at most10000 source rows, source result<=25MiB, at most28 ASCII bytes appended per row; selected is a subsequence; exact remaining source/parameter copies are bounded

selected-DE.tsv.rows: stable subsequence of Up/Down only when DE_members_evaluated=TRUE; no ID dedup/topK

outputs.source-test-set.tsv: exact complete original test-set bytes; source BH family remains all included_in_BH=TRUE rows, not just selected DE

trusted_caller_preconditions: Root/server chooses fixed local paths after ordinary authority and source-result authorization; no browser paths/ENV toggles
original complete five-output bundle and original runner receipt already validated and pinned
three input files must be exact immutable artifacts of ONE source result/contrast, not independently uploaded or mixed
Root provisions private exclusive empty staging and bounds/monitors process/resources; this R script is not a sandbox
source scientific state must match its original method/test-set; this core is not a replacement for the original five-output validator
verification_limit: hand-authored fixtures/static lexical/shape checks only; actual R parse/execution remains pending
